employeeNumber.label: Employee no.
employeeNumber.help: Employee number in the payroll system (follows the employee dimension)

payrollCode.label: Pay code
payrollCode.help: Pay code from the activity type (follows the activity dimension)

normHours.label: Standard hours
normHours.help: Daily norm × working days in the period (public holidays deducted)

workDays.label: Working days
workDays.help: Planned working days in the period (excluding public holidays/closure days)

maxDayHours.label: Longest day
maxDayHours.help: Highest daily total for one employee in the group

longDays.label: Days over 13 h
longDays.help: A daily total over 13 h leaves under 11 h of rest (the 11-hour rule)

avgWeeklyHours.label: Avg. hours/week
avgWeeklyHours.help: Logged hours per employee-week with entries or absence (the 48-hour rule)

weeksOver48h.label: Weeks over 48 h
weeksOver48h.help: Number of employee-weeks with over 48 h logged

fullWeeks.label: Weeks without a day off
fullWeeks.help: Weeks with entries on all 7 days and no absence day (24 h weekly rest)

longTermSick.label: Long-term sick
longTermSick.help: Continuous sickness period over 30 days in the period

longTermSickCount.label: Long-term sick (count)
longTermSickCount.help: Number of employees with a sickness period over 30 days

overtimeNet.label: Overtime net
overtimeNet.help: Earned − taken as time off − paid out

vacationDaysInPeriod.label: Holiday taken in the period
vacationDaysInPeriod.help: Holiday days (types that deduct the holiday balance) within the report period

quantityByWageType.label: Quantity per pay code
quantityByWageType.help: Hours/days per pay code via payroll mapping (Settings → Payroll)

payroll.label: Payroll report
payroll.description: Per employee for the payroll period: hours, absence in days and hours per type, flex, overtime and break deductions. For the payroll office.

sickness.label: Sickness absence
sickness.description: Sickness absence statistics per department and month: sick days, periods, absence percentage and long-term sickness (over 30 days).

absence.label: Absence
absence.description: All absence types (holiday, sickness, leave, care…) per employee or department — days and hours.

flex_overtime.label: Flex and overtime
flex_overtime.description: Balance development per period: standard hours, logged hours, flex delta and overtime earned/taken/paid out.

project_activity.label: Project and activity
project_activity.description: Hours split by project, activity type and department — for following up on teaching, preparation, meetings and so on.

vacation_account.label: Holiday accounts
vacation_account.description: Holiday accounts per holiday year: allotted, used and remaining for holiday and extra holiday days — per employee.

compliance.label: Compliance (Working Time Act)
compliance.description: Violations and warnings per employee and week: days over 13 h (11 h rest), weeks over 48 h, weeks without a day off (24 h weekly rest) and average weekly working time.

custom.label: Custom
custom.description: Free choice of dimensions and columns from the whole catalogue — build exactly the report you are missing.

page.title: Reports
page.chooseTemplateFirst: Save or choose a template first
page.footnote: CSV uses semicolons and Danish decimal commas. Rejected hours are excluded by default; open sick reports count up to and including today. Managers only see their own departments and employees.
page.noDataHint: Try a wider period, fewer filters or other columns.
page.truncated: The period contains more entries than the detail list can hold. The totals above are still calculated on all data. Choose a shorter period to see all details.
page.name: Name
page.shareWithOrg: Share with the whole organisation (all managers and HR can see it)
page.rollingNote: The period in the template is rolling: "Last month" sent on the 1st gives exactly last month's figures.
